title: Xpeng unveils Yoyo name as it advances robotaxi business
key_facts: Xpeng has named its robotaxi Xpeng Yoyo, announced on Weibo on Thursday.
The Chinese name is said to evoke a relaxed and carefree travel experience; the English name is easy to pronounce worldwide.
No date for public service and no scale of operations were announced.
On a 24 August earnings call, He Xiaopeng, Xpeng's chairman and chief executive, said the mass-produced robotaxis had completed more than 2,000 internal test rides in Guangzhou.
Xpeng aims to run passenger services without safety drivers in 2027 and plans partnerships with mobility platforms.
The robotaxi uses a vision-only system with no LiDAR or high-definition maps, and four in-house Turing chips.
quote_evidence: The Chinese electric vehicle maker announced the name on Weibo on Thursday, saying the Chinese name evokes a relaxed and carefree travel experience.
The announcement did not disclose a specific date for opening the service to the public or the scale of operations.
why_it_matters_hint: A brand name is a small step, but it shows the robotaxi moving toward a commercial launch.
notes: The name is an official company post. The timelines are company statements from July and August.
